translation.name: Kitap molinas men ringkat na alaata'ala: perjanjian baru

book.name: Lukas
book.title: Lele Pore Men Ia Tadulkon I LUKAS

content: Poosangadaian mampapatei i Yesus
Ramean Roti Sianta Ragina men ngaanon Paska karani'mo tempona.
Tanaasna imam ka' wawa ukum Torat nansarakmo salan se' too koi upa bo pampapatei i Yesus, gause i raaya'a matakutkon mian biai'.
Yudas nangakalkon bo pongorookonna i Yesus
Kasi Ibiliis niminsoopi i Yudas men ngaanon uga' i Iskariot. Yudas tonsoop sompulo' rua' murit ni Yesus.
Ia nomae'mo ka' nopootundunii tia tanaasna imam ka' tanaasna dadagai Laiganna Alaata'ala se' koi upa a bo sasalan mongorookon i Yesus na ko'ona i raaya'a.
Raaya'a nobeles tuu' kasi nontoon i Yudas se' bo taraionna i raaya'a doi'.
Yudas uga' nansangadaimo, kasi ia nansarak salan men daa pore bo pongorookonanna i Yesus na ko'ona i raaya'a, kasee wuni-wuni dako' inti'ionna mian biai'.
Nontoropotian bo kumaanan na ramean Paska
Takamo a tempona pangaramekonan Roti Sianta Ragina. Ilio iya'a mian tio mongkoyo' domba Paska men bo kaanon na baramean.
Mbaka' i Yesus nomosuu'mo i Petrus tii Yohanes tae-Na, “Rae' pontoropoti kumaanan Paska bo ko'onta'.”
Raaya'a nimikirawarmo taena, “Maana po'uus-Muu bo pontoropotianmai?”
Ia simbati i Yesus tae-Na, “Imamat ini'imari! Tempo i kuu minsoop na kota, kuu bo pootuung sa'angu' moro'one tumambu' mangawawa gumbang buke' a weer. Lolo' i ia pataka laigan men pinsoopionna,
ka' bantilkon na tombono laigan iya'a inta': ‘Guru nangaan tae-Na: maana a tampat men bo pangkaanan kakaan ramean Paska tia murit-Ku?’
Tombono laigan iya'a bo minsiso'kon na ko'omuu sa'angu' olisna parawawo men balaki' men noko toropotmo tia pakakasna. Toropoti a kakaanta inda'a.”
Mbaka' nomae'mo i Petrus tii Yohanes, ka' nungurumpaki giigii' iya'a sintutu' koi men ia ngaan i Yesus. Raaya'a uga' nontoropotimo kakaan men bo kaanon na Paska iya'a.
Kumaan Paska
Sarataa takamo a tempo kumaanan Paska iya'a, Yesus no'umoruangmo kumaan ruru-ruru' tia poposuu'-Na.
Kasi i Ia norobu na ko'ona tae-Na, “Yaku' mingkira' tuu' kumaan Paska kani'i ruru-ruru' tii kuu koo'po tia i Yaku' repaion!
Bantilkonon-Ku na ko'omuu se' Yaku' mase sianmo mangkaan kakaan Paska soosoodo pataka aratina Paska kani'i pipiile'konon na Batomundo'anna Alaata'ala.”
Noko daa koiya'a i Yesus nanganakatmo sasangkir men isian anggur, nobasukuur na Alaata'ala, kasi norobu tae-Na, “Ala kani'i, ka' poo'obos.
Bantilkonon-Ku na ko'omuu se' supu koini'i Yaku' sianmo minginum anggur soosoodo pataka kotakaanna Batomundo'anna Alaata'ala.”

Noko daa koiya'a i Yesus nangalamo roti, nobasukuur ka' nungurumpi-rumpik, kasi nongorookon na murit-Na ka' norobu tae-Na, “Ni'imo a wakang-Ku men nirookon bo pontololoki i kuu. Alaka' wawau a men koi kani'i bookoi pinginau'muu i Yaku'.”

Koiya'a uga', noko daa nangkaan, Ia nangalamo pinginuman tia anggur ka' nongorookon na ko'ona i raaya'a kasi norobu tae-Na, “Isiina pinginuman kani'i bookoi oosna toonna Alaata'ala men u'uru, men nipakadodor tia rara'-Ku, rara' men tonturo' bo ko'omuu.”
“Kasee piile'! Mian men bo pongorookon Yaku' isian kani'i tii Yaku'!
Anak Manusia sabole bo lapus koi men ia patukomo Alaata'ala, kasee silaka' a mian men mongorookon i Ia!”
Kasi i raaya'a nopoopikirawari simbaya'na se' ime a men bo mangawawau koiya'a.
Murit ni Yesus nunsurung se' ime a balaki'na
Mbaka' murit ni Yesus nopoomaso'mo gause munsurung ime a men balaki'na.
Yesus norobumo na ko'ona i raaya'a tae-Na, “Tomundo'na lipu' men sian minginti'i Alaata'ala mantalalais mianna, ka' i raaya'a mangaan wakana ‘Dadagai Rayat’.
Kasee kuu alia men koiya'a. Mian moola'na na ko'omuu tio sida koi men morio'na, ka' tanaas tio sida koi tutulungi.
Ime a men balaki'na: mian men taropion na meja', kabai se' mian men motarop? Sabole mian men taropion iya'a. Kasee Yaku' isian ruru-ruru' tii kuu bookoi mian men mantaropi.
Kuu a men sinampang ruru-ruru' tii Yaku' na giigii' repaan men nantakai i Yaku'.
Yaku' mantarai i kuu batomundo'an koi men i rookon Tama na surugaa na Ingku'.
Mbaka' i kuu bo kumaan ka' ba'inum ruru-ruru' tii Yaku' na Batomundo'an-Ku ka' i kuu uga' bo mongoruangi oruangan kobalaki'an ka' mungukumi sompulo' rua' bense'na lipu' Israel.”
Yesus nompopo'inti'ikon na murit-Na se' i Petrus bo minsasapu na Ko'ona
“Simon, Simon, imamat ini'imari! Ibiliis nama'ase'mo mimitopongi i kuu giigii' kada' i kuu bi sida koi ota'na gandum men nitaapi.
Kasee Yaku' daamo nansambayangkon i koo dako' imaawan rungku'. Ka' sarataa i koo mule'konmo na Ingku', koo tio mompopomoonggor utuus sa'angu' kaparasaya'an.”
Ia simbati i Petrus taena, “Tumpu, yaku' maloos a noangku minsoop na tarungkuan ka' pate ruru-ruru' tii Kuu!”
Kasee taeni Yesus, “Petrus, bantilkonon-Ku na ko'oom se' koo'po tia siok muntuturuu' ilio kani'i, koo noko porotolumo mangaan se' i koo sian poo'inti'i tii Yaku'.”
Dompet, pomantuan kabai bakoko'

Kasi i Yesus norobu na ko'ona tae-Na, “Tempo i Yaku' nomosuu' i kuu ka' sian nomoturang i kuu mangawawa dompet, pomantuan kabai sapato, kuu mbali' nunsuri isian men sianta na ko'omuu?” Ia simbati i raaya'a taena, “Sian!”
Taeni Yesus, “Kasee koini'i, ime a men isian dompet kabai tuuman tio wawaonna. Ime a men sianta bakoko'na tio mambalukkon jubana bo pingili bakoko'.

Bantilkonon-Ku na ko'omuu se' men nitulis na Alkitaap tio sida na wakang-Ku. Isian nitulis koi kani'imari: ‘Ia nigalal koi sa'angu' mian men ba'idek a gau'na.’ Upa men nitulis na Alkitaap iya'a koini'i pintanga'mo sida na Ingku'.”
Taena murit ni Yesus, “Tumpu, piile'! Kani'i isian bakoko' rurua'.” Ia simbati i Yesus tae-Na, “Daamo!”
Yesus nosambayang na Buu'na Zaitun
Yesus namarereimo kota ka' nomae' na Buu'na Zaitun men malia' rae'ion-Na, ka' murit-Na uga' nomae' tii Ia.
Sarataa notakamo inda'a, Ia norobumo na ko'ona i raaya'a tae-Na, “Sambayangmo dako' i kuu topongionna idek.”
Kasi i Ia nintisaal olo-oloa na ko'ona i raaya'a, ko'oloana toro koi balo'on tia watu, kasi Ia nobanintuur ka' nosambayang.
Tae-Na, “Oo Tamang-Ku! Too daa i Kuu sangada, oloakon na Ingku' a repaan men tio rumpakion-Ku kani'i. Kasee alia mongololo' pingkira'-Ku. Lolo' a pingkira'-Muu.” [
Kasi sa'angu' malaa'ikat notaka na Ko'ona ka' nompopomoonggor i Ia.
Siasa tuu' a noa ni Yesus. Mbali' iya'a, Ia nosambayangmo tuu'. Ugot-Na koi rara' men tumuro' na tano'.]
Noko daa nosambayang, Yesus nomule'konmo soosoodo na murit-Na. Ia takai i Yesus i raaya'a nokoroyotmo gause masiongo'.
Kasi i Ia norobu na ko'ona tae-Na, “Nongko'upa se' i kuu royot? Wangon ka' sambayangmo dako' i kuu topongionna idek.”
Yesus nirakop
Pintanga' i Yesus dauga' morobu, notakamo a mian sa'angu' lulusan. Raaya'a ia tanaasi i Yudas men tonsoop sompulo' rua' murit ni Yesus. Kasi i Yudas nombaale'e ni Yesus bo mongooki i Ia.
Kasee i Yesus norobu na ko'ona tae-Na, “Yudas, too tia nongooki iya'a koo mangakalkon Anak Manusia?”
Tempo murit ni Yesus men isian indo'o nimiile' upa men nosida, raaya'a nimikirawarmo taena, “Tumpu, too i raaya'a tio lawuionmai tia bakoko'?”
Kasi sa'angu' mian men nitakai indo'o nontotok ata'na Imam Moola' tamban nokopantas tilingana paraas uanan.
Kasee i Yesus norobu tae-Na, “Aliamomo'!” Kasi i Ia nongkoyong tilingana mian iya'a ka' nengelesi'i.

Noko daa koiya'a i Yesus norobumo na tanaasna imam ka' na tanaasna dadagai Laiganna Alaata'ala tia motu-motu'a men notaka indo'o bo pangarakop i Ia tae-Na, “Pansaruimuu se' i Yaku' too mian puraga mbali' i kuu notaka poto'inton bakoko' tia popool?
Sanda' ilio i Yaku' monda'a tii kuu mimisiso' mian na tolodona Laiganna Alaata'ala, see i kuu sian nangarakop Yaku'. Kasee ni'imo a tempomuu balimang, ka' koini'i kuasana kapintungan a mingilimang.”
Petrus ninsasapu ni Yesus
Raaya'a nangarakopmo i Yesus ka' nangawawa na laiganna Imam Moola'. Petrus nuntuntuni kasee olo-oloa.
Na tanga'na tolodo iya'a isian mian namatu'u apu ka' i raaya'a no'umoruang na tiku-tikumna apu iya'a. Petrus uga' no'umoruangmo nintingola' na ko'ona i raaya'a.
Isian sa'angu' ata' wiwine nimiile' i Petrus oru-oruang karani' apu iya'a. Ia ninggimatai i Petrus ka' komburi'na ia norobu taena, “Mian kaya'a uga' poololo' tii Yesus!”
Kasee i Petrus ninsasapu taena, “Taasi'. Yaku' sian ninginti'i i Ia!”
Sian paraa nanau', mian sambana uga' nimiile' i Petrus ka' norobu taena, “Koo uga' tonsoop tii raaya'a!” Taena i Petrus, “Sian, taasi' i yaku'.”
Toro sa'angu' jaam a noporusanna, mian sambana norobumo boolak taena, “Daa tuutuu' mian kaya'a poololo' tii Yesus, gause i ia uga' samba Galilea!”
Kasee ia simbati i Petrus taena, “Taasi'! Yaku' sian ninginti'i upa men koo porobukon.” Tempo iya'a uga' pintanga' i Petrus morobu, siok nuntuturuu'mo.

Tumpu ningilingamo ka' nintioki i Petrus. Kasi i Petrus tinonginau' se' Tumpu noko pambantilkonmo na ko'ona men tae-Na, “Koo'po tia siok muntuturuu' ilio kani'i, koo noko porotolumo minsasapu na Ingku'.”
Mbaka' no'umuarmo i Petrus ka' nowiri tamban bolingongoton.
Yesus ni'iroki ka' nipukul
Mian men nandagai i Yesus ningirokimo ka' numukul Ia.
Raaya'a nongompodi ro'up-Na ka' nimikirawar na Ko'ona taena, “Io, ngaan too ime a numukul i Koo”
Dauga' biai' soosoodo a wurung men irokikononna i raaya'a i Yesus.
Yesus na aropna Mahkama Agama
Ma'ulopna, motu-motu'ana lipu' Yahudi, tanaasna imam tia wawa ukum Torat nobarimpungmo, kasi nangawawa i Yesus na Mahkama Agamana i raaya'a.
Taena i raaya'a, “Kalu i Koo kani'i Tomundo' Pansalamatkon, bantilkon na ko'omai.” Ia simbati i Yesus tae-Na, “Maupo bantilkonon-Ku na ko'omuu, kuu sian mamarasaya.
Ka' kalu Yaku' mimikirawar na ko'omuu, kuu uga' sian minsimbati.
Kasee supu koini'i Anak Manusia bo umoruang na paraas uananna Alaata'ala men Pungkuasai.”
Raaya'a giigii' norobumo taena, “Kalu koiya'a, Koo kani'i Anakna Alaata'ala?” Ia simbati i Yesus tae-Na, “Koi men taemuu.”
Kasi i raaya'a norobu taena, “Bo upa ka' dauga' mansarak mian bo pinginti'ianta! Daa kita rongormo a men Ia porobukon!”
